data.name: Lure Prey
data.description: Cloaked wolves are skilled at maintaining a harmless guise even while they silently prepare to strike against their enemies. A cloaked wolf receives a +%1 morale bonus on all Disguise and Sleight of Hand checks. When a cloaked wolf uses Sleight of Hand to draw a hidden weapon, this bonus doubles.|CloakedWolfSkillBonus
